finding: For collection source inclusion conditions, metafieldInteger is deprecated as of API 2026-10 and removed as of 2027-01; metafieldInt should be used from 2026-10 onward.
old_approach: Reuse metafieldInteger in collection-condition logic regardless of Admin API version.
new_rule_or_hypothesis: For API 2026-10+ collection inclusion conditions, use metafieldInt; treat metafieldInteger as legacy and do not interpret a schema failure as evidence that no matching products exist.
test_metric: Version-aware collection condition validates successfully and returns expected candidate set; schema/operator errors are separated from zero-result outcomes.
failure_fallback: If API version is unknown, fail closed as COLLECTION_SCHEMA_VERSION_UNVERIFIED; do not silently retry incompatible field names or score an empty result as demand evidence.
provenance: Official Shopify GraphQL Admin API documentation, fetched 2026-10-05.
